moves.name: Gladius (Light Punch)
moves.notes: Charged version breaks armor. Can hold down the button to charge the attack, data listed as 'no charge...max charge'. Transitions to a two-hit attack into a hit throw when fully charged. Total frames and recovery frames listed for charge version are for whiffed hit. One hit of upper body hit armor starting at frame 5 until 3-6 frames before becoming active (affected by charge).

moves.notes: Charged version breaks armor. Can hold down the button to charge the attack, data listed as 'no charge...max charge'. Transitions to a two-hit attack into a hit throw when fully charged. Total frames and recovery frames listed for charge version are for whiffed hit. One hit of upper body hit armor starting at frame 5 until 3-6 frames before becoming active (affected by charge).

moves.name: Gladius (Heavy Punch)
moves.notes: Charged version breaks armor. Can hold down the button to charge the attack, data listed as 'no charge...max charge'. Transitions to a two-hit attack into a hit throw when fully charged. Total frames and recovery frames listed for charge version are for whiffed hit. One hit of upper body hit armor starting at frame 5 until 3-6 frames before becoming active (affected by charge).

moves.name: Gladius (Overdrive)
moves.notes: Breaks armor. Can hold down the button to charge the attack, data listed as 'no charge...max charge'. Transitions to a two-hit attack into a hit throw when fully charged. Total frames and recovery frames listed for charge version are for whiffed hit. One hit of upper body hit armor starting at frame 1 until becoming active (affected by charge). Charged version grants two hits of upper body hit armor. Adds 30% scaling in combos as of May 2024 patch.
